design_conditions.text: Fresh opaque Session only; no imported CoreApplication/GameCore/BattleCore or externally supplied/deserialized/mutated log.
Every later whole candidate clone prepares its actual future write side after clone and before operations, including future opaque fork; no prepared boolean survives later Arc-sharing clone.
Optional trace must not hold BattleEventLog/BattleEventEntries Arc clones; owned observations/source handles cannot alter event-entry sharing, work or admission.
Pre-copy limits/shape work and post-copy poll remain fallible at candidate owner; no changes to infallible recorder identity/append contract.
Outer control failure takes precedence; restore/drop complete candidate before any mandatory receipt/session publication.

separate_gaps_or_exclusions.text: entries_after_seq clones entries to a new Vec; no log Arc sharing but separate deep-copy work/retention seam.
Native new/from_entries/deserialization/public DerefMut/fixture mutation are not generally controlled by candidate COW seam; fresh-only owner excludes imported state.
Current debug/test terminal log copies occur after final BattleEnd, with no supported follow-up runtime write before active battle removal; arbitrary fixture writes after terminal are excluded.
Preparing COW does not bound unique-owner appends, accounting scans/eviction, other whole-Core clone fields, allocator peak or copy wall-time.
Spawn reserve_request precedes rollback snapshot, so preparation failure restores post-reservation Pending basis inside private candidate; full A preservation belongs to outer aggregate discard.
